mapper.select: SELECT p.PO_CODE, p.PO_START, c.CUS_NAME, p.CREATER, CASE WHEN s.PROD_CNT > 1 THEN s.REP_NAME || ' 외 ' || (s.PROD_CNT - 1) || '건' ELSE s.REP_NAME END AS PRODUCT_NAME, c.BIZ_TYPE, p.PO_STATUS, p.NOTES, p.EX_DATE, s.SUP_AMT -- 과세 항목만 합산한 주문금액 FROM PURCHASE_ORDER p JOIN CUSTOMER c ON c.CUS_CODE = p.CUS_CODE JOIN ( SELECT pod.PO_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT pod.PRODUCT_CODE) AS PROD_CNT, MIN(pdt.PRODUCT_NAME) AS REP_NAME, -- 과세 항목만 SUP_AMT 합산 SUM( CASE WHEN pod.VAT_TYPE = '과세' THEN NVL(pod.SUP_AMT, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS SUP_AMT FROM PO_DETAIL pod JOIN PRODUCT pdt ON pdt.PRODUCT_CODE = pod.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY pod.PO_ID ) s ON s.PO_ID = p.PO_ID WHERE c.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ORDER BY p.PO_START DESC

SELECT d.DO_CODE, d.DO_CREATED, c.CUS_NAME, CASE WHEN s.PROD_CNT > 1 THEN s.REP_NAME || ' 외 ' || (s.PROD_CNT - 1) || '건' ELSE s.REP_NAME END AS PRODUCT_NAME, d.ADDR, d.EX_DATE, d.DO_STATUS FROM DELIVERY_ORDER d JOIN CUSTOMER c ON d.CUS_CODE = c.CUS_CODE JOIN ( SELECT dd.DO_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT dd.PRODUCT_CODE) AS PROD_CNT, -- 품목 수 MIN(p.PRODUCT_NAME) AS REP_NAME -- 대표 품목명 (사전순) FROM DO_DETAIL dd JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CODE = dd.PRODUCT_CODE GROUP BY dd.DO_NO ) s ON s.DO_NO = d.DO_NO WHERE d.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ORDER BY d.DO_CREATED DESC
